About the Moxie Monday group ride

A ride for women, trans, femme and non-binary riders on any kind of bike. Casual pace, frequent regroups and breaks, usually under 20 miles. Meets at Westlake Park. The same crew runs an annual W/T/F alley cat.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
